title: Acme rollout update
text: Acme SSO is still blocked on SAML mapping. The platform team is investigating. The customer checkpoint is today.

title: Escalation from customer success
text: The Acme champion asked for a same-day update on the SSO rollout. The SSO blocker is still blocked and unresolved ahead of the checkpoint.

title: Globex export thread
text: The Globex export timeout is resolved. The customer confirmed the 23 September export succeeded. This thread can stay closed.

title: Closing the export escalation
text: No further action on the Globex export timeout. Do not reopen the incident. The customer is satisfied and the escalation is closed.

title: Europe aside
text: Someone said Initech might expand in Europe next year. No details were shared and no follow-up was booked.

title: Unclear Europe ask
